Parts and holes of groups of triangles

Source: R/tri_prepare.R
tri_structure.Rd

The number of polygons (parts) and holes of each group, as ST_NumGeometries() and ST_NumInteriorRings() (summed over parts) give them for the dissolved groups. These need the boundary rings, so they are a read on a pool from tri_prepare() and a dissolve otherwise.

Usage

tri_structure(x, group = NULL)

Arguments

x

A wkpool_tri.

group

Integer group id per triangle (1-based, NA to leave a triangle out). The default is the triangles' feature, or one group when the pool has no feature.

Value

A data frame with one row per group id from 1 to the largest and columns group, n_parts, n_holes and n_rings.

Examples

v <- data.frame(.vx = 1:6, x = c(0, 1, 1, 0, 2, 2), y = c(0, 0, 1, 1, 0, 1))
tri <- new_wkpool_tri(v, vx0 = c(1, 1, 2, 2), vx1 = c(2, 3, 5, 6),
                      vx2 = c(3, 4, 6, 3), feature = c(1, 1, 2, 2))
p <- tri_prepare(tri)
tri_is_prepared(p)
#> [1] TRUE
tri_measures(p)
#>   group area perimeter centroid_x centroid_y   point_x   point_y xmin ymin xmax
#> 1     1    1         4        0.5        0.5 0.6666667 0.3333333    0    0    1
#> 2     2    1         4        1.5        0.5 1.6666667 0.3333333    1    0    2
#>   ymax
#> 1    1
#> 2    1
tri_structure(p)
#>   group n_parts n_holes n_rings
#> 1     1       1       0       1
#> 2     2       1       0       1
